hero.subtitle: Vračar • Belgrade
hero.description: Una Trattoria brings authentic Italian cuisine to Belgrade.

about.title: About Us
about.text: Una Trattoria was created from a love for Italian cuisine and simple, well-known recipes. We make Neapolitan pizza from long-fermented dough, baked at high temperature with carefully selected ingredients.

menu.title: About the Menu
menu.text: The Una Trattoria menu offers a diverse selection of dishes. It includes Neapolitan pizzas, pasta and sandwiches, with combinations that are easy to choose and remember.

footer.description: Neapolitan discipline, seasonal ingredients and precision in every bite.
